_comment: HAND-MADE, NOT RECORDED (task C2, 2026-11-19). Written by hand in the shapes the Legistar Web API documents (https://webapi.legistar.com/Help: Events, EventItems); no request was made to any Legistar host. Client names, body ids, event ids, URLs and text are invented. Task H1 replaces this with a recorded Salem answer. Layout: `events[<EventBodyId>]` is the answer to that body's events query, `eventitems[<EventId>]` the answer to that event's eventitems query; every item text holds SENTINEL-ITEM-TEXT and every person field SENTINEL-PERSON-NAME, which must never reach a withheld body's feed or cache.
